description.narrative:
1. Continuation of the Climate Launchpad Programme (CLP) Africa in twelve countries (Kenya, Mozambique, Nigeria, South Africa, Tanzania, Uganda, and Colombia (full support); Angola, Cape Verde, Ghana, Egypt, Mauritius, Morocco (bootcamp support only). 2. An Oceans and Blue Economy workstream to expand CLP to one additional Pacific Island country (either Tonga or Vanuatu), as well as continuing support in Fiji, Papua New Guinea plus Vietnam. This is in line with Ireland’s SIDS Strategy. This will build activity in the local ecosystem at the earliest stages. This work package will also continue Climate KIC’s Pacific Islands ‘coach the coach’ programme, allowing the partner to build the capacity of local business coaches working in the climate innovation space.
3. Continuing to develop the Adaptation Innovation Cluster in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, bringing together organisations, such as government agencies, companies and research institutes to strengthen climate resilience through innovation and deliver the Adaptation and Resilience (A&R) ClimAccelerator in Africa.
4. Expanding the reach of inclusivity support and the range of gender toolkits and content through a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion work package, broadened beyond gender to encompass other marginalised groups, based on inclusivity and intersectionality.
5. Cross-cutting Programme Management, Communications and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning to support this longer-term vision and programme.
